root_cause: Daily collector only read brand tenant, missing canonical personal LinkedIn. Latest cumulative post snapshots have non-equivalent publication ages.
fix: Reuse daily collector for 3 tenant-scoped channels with publish timing/content traits and provider-observed 48h cohort trend. Require >=5 samples in both cohorts for each metric.
prevention: Do not infer views, identities, visitors, leads, revenue, causal effects or improvements without corresponding provider and attribution proof. Keep one scheduler and established learning/application owners.
